answer: Mechanism: pulse probes plus a per-key crystal ledger. Each identity must answer randomized pulse challenges inside a jittered window tied to its own secret schedule. Probe outcomes append to that key's crystal record, which vote weighting reads; keys missing probes drop to violet status and lose weight until re-earned. Attacker cost: probes arrive unpredictably, so one operator cannot multiplex thousands of keys through one fast process; each puppet needs a dedicated responder around the clock, so cost grows linearly per identity, while an honest user keeps one schedule.
